verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents an official MCP server that gives AI models a standard interface to its scraping, structured extraction and crawling capabilities (docs-8, probe-4). A first-party GitHub repo (hyperbrowserai/mcp) backs this up and lists concrete tools such as `scrape_webpage` (gh-1). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and detailed evidence of client setup or configuration and the full tool surface.
